faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) for its Department of Medical Sciences and Technology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced under IIT Madras Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The position announced is Project Technical Support-III on a temporary basis for research projects.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III post under advertisement number ICSR/PR/Advt. 203/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications is 12 October 2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three years graduate degree in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or related domains with 3 years experience or a PG degree, OR a First Class Four Years Graduate Degree in Engineering, IT, or CS with 3 years experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Technical Support-III post is up to 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA at 30%, totaling Rs. 36,400/- per month including HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIT Madras Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates must register and apply through the official careers portal of IIT Madras ICSR.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on online applications followed by a written test or interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply online?
faq.answer: You can access the official online application portal and find current openings through the official website link provided in the important links section.
